text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Narita Brian is defeated at the Arima Kinen, yet Hishi Amazon can't come to terms with her own victory, having overcome what she long viewed as an insurmountable wall.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Narita Brian bluntly tells her to accept the results. She adds that she isn't the type to lose once and just give up.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The new year brings the start of her senior year, and our next goal—the Hanshin Daishoten.
